I'd like to see what you're already doing before I suggest anything, so let me check your deadlift history and your current program. Nothing is logged for deadlifts yet, and you don't have an active program, so I can't see your current numbers or where your back is starting from. I can still give you the general picture.

For a stronger lower back on deadlifts, the usual work is hip-hinge movements that load the erectors with controlled reps: Romanian deadlifts, good mornings, back extensions and reverse hypers. Keep the load moderate, around 3 sets of 8 to 10 reps with 2 to 3 reps left in the tank, and add weight or reps each week. Log your deadlift sessions here so I can see your loads and progress.

If you want that built into a full program, tell me what you're aiming for, such as a bigger deadlift or a 3-day week, and the Build it button will put a plan together for you.
